entrada.texto:
Page 10 of 22
Mallick et al. Discover Internet of Things             (2025) 5:90 
contract functionalities. A device proxy is used to identify and register these devices. All 
actions done by these devices are watched by the device proxy. Registration of a device 
requires proof of identity. The decentralised application (dApp) based on smart con -
tracts connects all users and patients to the healthcare system, addressing the concerns 
of security, privacy, scalability, trustworthiness, and transparency. Users’ data uploaded 
using the decentralized app are stored in the Interplanetary File System. A crypto -
graphic hash value generated from this file will be uploaded to the Blockchain network. 
A step-by-step process for using this proposed framework to retrieve the files is pro -
vided in Algorithm 2. When a user connects to the decentralized application and desires 
to access a file from this system, the user must first send a request to the system. The 
file’s unique Hash value will be retrieved from the Blockchain network. This hash value 
will be checked against the hash values in the interplanetary file system. Once the hash 
value has been matched, the user will obtain the appropriate file for further processing. 
The encryption and decryption process of proposed healthcare system is presented in 
Algorithm 3.

resposta.resumo: O trabalho propõe um framework onde um device proxy registra dispositivos mediante prova de identidade, e uma dApp baseada em smart contracts conecta usuários e pacientes ao sistema de saúde. Dados são armazenados no IPFS e seu hash criptográfico é gravado na blockchain; a recuperação ocorre mediante verificação do hash. O processo de criptografia/decriptação é descrito no Algoritmo 3.

perfil.solucao: A device proxy is used to identify and register these devices.
perfil.possibilidades: Integrar identidade auto‑soberana (SSI) para substituir a prova de identidade baseada em proxy; Avaliar o impacto da latência de rede na recuperação de arquivos em ambientes de cidades inteligentes; Comparar diferentes algoritmos de hash (ex.: SHA‑256 vs Keccak‑256) quanto ao consumo energético dos dispositivos IoT de saúde; Extender o framework para suportar computação de borda (edge computing) e nuvem híbrida, medindo desempenho e escalabilidade.
